title: Section navigation for the eight core Sounds of Odisha stories
basis: Inspection found the eight core articles map raw story.blocks to unanchored h2 headings and expose no contents navigation, unlike the nine further-reading stories. Huluhuli alone has eight titled sections; readers cannot link to an individual passage or jump to its notes.
acceptance: Give all eight core sound articles an In this story contents disclosure with each canonical heading and a sources destination. Preserve every narrative paragraph, list, source note, illustration credit, reading-trail link and existing search eligibility. Verify unique fragment targets, keyboard selection and Escape, opening source notes, direct fragment arrival and phone/desktop layout. Publish the passing reviewed head through the approved main workflow and save live evidence before counting once.
limits: Navigation only. No new factual claims, audio, practitioner review or search eligibility.
